name: positron-deck-suite
description: Positron Deck extension, Stream Deck companion and documentation

scripts.build: npm run generate && npm --prefix extension run compile && npm --prefix streamdeck run build
scripts.test: npm run generate && npm --prefix extension test && npm --prefix streamdeck test && node scripts/check-docs.mjs
scripts.package: npm run generate && npm --prefix extension run package && npm --prefix streamdeck run package
